releaseNotes: Discord Rich Presence (RPC): Live status integration displaying launcher activity, active ETS2 Convoy/Singleplayer sessions, and elapsed session timer

Auto-Update Redirect & URL Resilience: Expanded trusted host whitelist (GitHub release-assets/objects redirects, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel) for seamless auto-updates
